capabilities: Lock accidental drag and drop in sidebars
Toggle dragging via the move button
Trigger context menu on long press on mobile
disambiguation: Not a file manager; it only locks existing sidebar drag-and-drop behavior behind an explicit toggle.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README discloses AI-assisted development with human review and states it is not affiliated with official Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian sidebars allow drag and drop, which users can trigger accidentally when clicking items.
summary: Guard plugin that prevents accidental drag and drop in Obsidian sidebars, enabling dragging only when explicitly requested.
